scope: Read-only basis frozen before candidate edits; no Apple runtime acceptance

apple_document.support: Apple documents test-without-building with an xctestrun file and refers to the xcodebuild.xctestrun manual for its parameters.

apple_manual_content.distribution: Third-party mirror of the Apple-authored manual; current selected runner manual must independently support the option before use.
apple_manual_content.exact_statement: When this flag is set, xcodebuild will not install test artifacts to the destination during testing.

startup_order: Original native app/SQLite/space activity predates the Swift Testing method body. An inventory newly inserted at verify() entry would not prove pre-account-open bytes.
preservation: Retain every existing Swift path/device/inode/creation and native semantic comparison. The candidate will suppress a second installation, never accept a second unproved relocation.
